semantics.note: The normalisation preserves reported association, both death categories, cumulative timing, and Wikipedia coverage without asserting proven causation.

contract.note: The contract gives an ordinary reading of several reported deaths and Wikipedia tracking. The evidence exceeds the minimum count; no precise numerical interpretation determines the result.

evidence.note: The January 14, 2026 permanent revision establishes Wikipedia coverage before the statement and collects reports involving suicide and homicide.
The September 2025 hearing account records two distinct chatbot-associated suicide reports. It establishes public allegations, not proven causation.

The December 2025 complaint publicly alleges a chatbot connection to two additional deaths, including a homicide. Its allegations satisfy the reported-association criterion without establishing causation.

reviews.rationale: Before January 15, 2026, the hearing account and complaint documented at least four distinct reported chatbot-associated deaths, including suicide and homicide. The dated Wikipedia revision independently establishes that Wikipedia was collecting such cases. No material counterevidence appears in the packet.
